scope.population: union of PIT S&P1500 membership intervals, inclusive start/end, dates 2021-07-06 through current R2 store last_day
scope.values_read: Parquet date index only. No OHLC, volume, transactions, forward returns, labels, model outputs, signals, trials or market-outcome calculations.
scope.identity_scope: ticker-string coverage only; historical security identity/rename/ticker-reuse remains unadmitted

corrections: Initial local run stopped before bulk scan because a pandas Timestamp was compared with datetime.date; effect none; corrected in place.

Initial bulk reader addressed membership join keys as artifact names. Canonical Massive mapping preserves vendor dot spelling, so BF-B/BRK-B/CWEN-A/MOG-A were reconciled to BF.B/BRK.B/CWEN.A/MOG.A and reread. No proposed-population join key had multiple R2 candidates.

interpretation.reason: The literal PIT file produces high date availability, but most missing cells arise from floor-seeded SP400/SP600 interval starts whose historical ticker/security continuity is not established. Earliest price is not a lawful listing/membership date substitute.
interpretation.safe_use: Retain unavailable/ambiguous cells explicitly. Scientific owner must adopt an identity-safe population rule before outcome access; do not silently delete floor-seeded cells or narrow to winners/survivors after seeing outcomes.
interpretation.historical_evidence_ceiling: RETROSPECTIVE unless stronger original receipt/correction-vintage evidence exists.
